note: City campground at 255 Bluebird Lane on the north edge of Grove City (Meeker County): one row of 14 sites between the park road and the trees along the lake's east shore; site 14 is grass only. --Claude
summary: City page + 2026 fee schedule + site guide read: 14 sites, 20/30/50-amp, water, sewer at 12, showers; $30 night / $150 week / $500 month; about May 1-Oct 1; reserve by phone. Hookups electric 30 -> 50, sewer added. Not waterfront -> lakeview lead. Website 404 -> campground-1; phone 320-857-2322.
flags: WATERFRONT not waterfront -> lakeview lead (upgrade, reviewer to decide). The stored evidence ('OSM: only a small pond / wastewater feature within ~50 m; no lake or river') is wrong: the campground sits on the east shore of a natural lake of roughly 18 ha (about 300 x 760 m, irregular wooded shoreline) on the north edge of town. On Esri z19 the pads of sites 8-9 (about 45.1555,-94.6813) and the row of sites 1-14 (45.1546 to 45.1566 along -94.6812) are about 15-25 m from the water across mown grass, behind a thin, single line of trees on the bank; the city's own site-guide image shows the numbered sites against the water. A thin tree line makes it a view, not on-water, so lakeview; no site shows an open, treeless apron to the water. Lake name not confirmed (Overpass unavailable).

LONG-STAY (flag, no drop): the city rents by the night ($30), week ($150) and month ($500); nightly rate posted on the city page and fee schedule, reservations by phone. No seasonal leases offered. Occupancy could not be checked (no engine); the undated Esri frame shows two or three RVs on the 14 sites. A public city campground, not a seasonal-lease park on the evidence read.
WEBSITE: stored https://grovecitymn.gov/campground now serves the city's 404 page. Replace with https://grovecitymn.gov/campground-1
PHONE missing: city office (320) 857-2322 ('Contact the city office at (320) 857-2322 for reservation information'). Suggest 320-857-2322.
HOOKUPS electric 30 -> 50 and sewer added: the site guide lists 30/50-amp at most sites and sewer at 12 of 14; the old derived '30-amp' came from note prose.
Pin 45.155263,-94.681312 sits on the site row; no move.
